tasks.label: rCore: Start QEMU GDB server
tasks.command: qemu-system-riscv64 -machine virt -nographic -bios '${workspaceFolder}/bootloader/rustsbi-qemu.bin' -device loader,file='${workspaceFolder}/os/target/riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf/release/os.bin',addr=0x80200000 -S -gdb tcp:127.0.0.1:1234 -pidfile '${workspaceFolder}/os/target/vscode-qemu.pid' & qemu_pid=$!; sleep 0.2; kill -0 $qemu_pid; echo '[vscode] QEMU GDB server ready'; wait $qemu_pid

tasks.label: rCore: Stop QEMU GDB server
tasks.command: pid_file='${workspaceFolder}/os/target/vscode-qemu.pid'; if [ -f "$pid_file" ]; then qemu_pid=$(cat "$pid_file"); kill "$qemu_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$pid_file"; fi
